==Ingredients==

* 1 can (16 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) [[Cookbook:Cherry|cherry]] pie filling
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] yellow [[Cookbook:Cake Mix|cake mix]]
* ⅛ cup softened [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Nuts and seeds|nuts]]
* [[Cookbook:Ice Cream|Ice cream]], as desired

==Procedure==

# Pour cherry pie filling into a [[Cookbook:Slow Cooker|slow cooker]], spreading it evenly across the bottom of the crock.
# In a medium-size bowl, combine cake mix and butter until the mixture is crumbly.
# Sprinkle evenly over cherries.
# Sprinkle nuts evenly over cake mix.
# Set slow cooker on low, cover and allow to cook for 3 hours.
# Serve hot, right from the slow cooker, or serve over ice cream, if desired.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Any fruit pie filling will do.
* Refrigerate extra portions of this cobbler and mix it into hot oatmeal or yogurt for a breakfast treat.
